# 0.1 to 0.2 differences

Exact old and new fields are retained in the fixtures and repeated here. A source rewrite is marked yes only when the recorded rewritten input produced the old HTML.

## CS-1: color-swatch.test.ts

Clauses: C2-H-009. Source rewrite gives 0.1 HTML: no.

**0.1 input**

```carve
:color[#fff]{contrast .x #y}
```

**0.1 HTML**

```html
<p><span class="swatch-label x" id="y" style="background:#fff;color:#000">#fff</span></p>
```

**0.2 input**

```carve
:color[#fff]{contrast .x #y}
```

**0.2 HTML**

```html
<p><span id="y" class="swatch-label x" style="background:#fff;color:#000">#fff</span></p>
```

## CS-2: color-swatch.test.ts

Clauses: C2-H-009. Source rewrite gives 0.1 HTML: no.

**0.1 input**

```carve
:color[#fff]{contrast style="opacity:0.5"}
```

**0.1 HTML**

```html
<p><span style="opacity:0.5" class="swatch-label">#fff</span></p>
```

**0.2 input**

```carve
:color[#fff]{contrast style="opacity:0.5"}
```

**0.2 HTML**

```html
<p><span class="swatch-label" style="opacity:0.5">#fff</span></p>
```

## LT-04: list-table Tier-3 extension > keeps a header-row rowspan in one body group (^ in body)

Clauses: C2-B-174. Source rewrite gives 0.1 HTML: no.

**0.1 input**

```carve

::: list-table
- - A
  - B
  - C
- - ^
  - E
  - F
:::
```

**0.1 HTML**

```html
<table>
  <tbody>
    <tr><th scope="col" rowspan="2">A</th><th scope="col">B</th><th scope="col">C</th></tr>
    <tr><td>E</td><td>F</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

**0.2 input**

```carve

  - B
  - C
- - ^
  - E

:::
```

```html

    <tr><th scope="col">A</th><th scope="col">B</th><th scope="col">C</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>^</td><td>E</td><td>F</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```
